d: In this conversation, Congress leader Sonia Gandhi reflects on living with her mother-in-law, former Prime Minister Indira Gandhi, noting that she assimilated discipline, courage, determination, and ideological commitment. Reflecting on her early married life when her husband Rajiv Gandhi worked as a pilot, she explains her reluctance regarding his entry into politics, stating, 'I was very against, against my husband joining politics, because I had watched my mother-in-law all those years, you know, dedicating her complete life to her work.'
